purpose: Freeze the PV11-Acq analysis code BEFORE any steered episode exists, so the reported metric cannot be chosen after seeing the +-4 result. This manifest is separate from pv11_amendment_01.json on purpose: adding an analyzer hash to the amendment would require editing an artifact whose value is that it has not been edited since it was committed.

references_amendment.relationship: This manifest is downstream of the amendment and does not modify it. Every reading rule enforced by the analyzer is specified there; the analyzer is the executable form of those rules, not a new decision.

analyzer.role: the single definition of every PV11-Acq number

guard_test.role: drives all 14 fail-closed guards by synthetic mutation of the stored alpha=0 file, plus two must-succeed controls

frozen_before.statement: No PV11 episode with alpha != 0 had been generated or inspected when these hashes were computed. The alpha=0 cell was already complete and had been inspected; that is what the amendment records.

primary_metric.name: first_step_probe_sampling_low_rate_contrast
primary_metric.definition: P(first action = SAMPLE probe | low_n/low_rate) - P(first action = SAMPLE probe | matched_n/low_rate)
primary_metric.why_only_this_pair: In both low_rate cells the probe's displayed rate is .40 and the probe is NOT the displayed best arm, so sampling it cannot be rate-chasing. Probe label, display row, displayed rate and the other three arms are identical across the pair; ONLY sample size differs.

slot_weighted.denominator: all 20 design slots of a cell
slot_weighted.role: continuity with the frozen gate, which was defined this way

unique_prompt.why: Latent rank is invisible at the first step, so several slots render a byte-identical prompt. At temperature=0 those are one decision repeated, not independent samples.

primary_metric.invalid_handling: ITT is primary: an invalid first action counts in the denominator and in no numerator. valid-only is reported beside it with its own denominator.
primary_metric.estimand_scope: FIRST ACTION ONLY. After it, choice and realized reward fork the trajectory, so no later round is state-matched across alpha.

descriptive_only.can_support: that sample size changed choice with the displayed rate held at .60
descriptive_only.cannot_support: any information-seeking motive: there the probe IS the displayed best arm, so sampling it is inseparable from rate-chasing -- the structure behind PV10-C's deprecated .774
descriptive_only.ruling: excluded from the primary metric; may not re-characterize the low_rate result

power.enforced_in_code: The analyzer prints NO p-value for the primary contrast. With 3 positive events a significance test would imply a precision this design does not have.
power.null_wording: 'not detected at this low-power baseline'. NEVER 'RSN does not affect acquisition' and never an equivalence claim: a null cannot be distinguished from insufficient power here.

fails_closed_on: a cell that does not present the same 80 state_uids as the others
fewer or more than 20 states in any of the four cells
an alpha that disagrees with the flag it was passed under
commitment runs inside a cell declaring block=acquisition
any drift in state_id / cell / display_order / opening_counts / latent_probs / tape_key / true_best / displayed_best / probe_label / horizon
any drift in protocol / state-bank / parser version
a differing state-bank hash, manifest hash, model/mask fingerprint or mask path
steering_fires != expected_fires, a None fire count, a steered cell with 0 fires, or an alpha=0 cell with nonzero fires
an interface tag that does not match its own declared scope
pairing_attestation.asserts_rather_than_intersects: A silent seed intersection would reintroduce the survival selection that made PV10-A's cross-cell accuracy uninterpretable.
pairing_attestation.interface_tag_is_EXPECTED_to_differ: The alpha=0 cell is the original full-bank run (H5-20, block=all); the steered cells are acquisition-only (H20, _blkacquisition). Requiring equality would force re-running a baseline that genuinely predates the amendment. Each tag is instead checked against its own scope.

alpha0_source.handling: Read in place and filtered to its 80 acquisition states. NOT copied, NOT resumed into a new directory, NOT regenerated. Re-running it to make a label match would replace a real pre-amendment baseline with a later one.

not_analysed.commitment_block: Withdrawn on construct grounds (pv11_amendment_01.json). The analyzer loads acquisition states only and raises if handed commitment data. No commitment or threshold conclusion may be drawn from PV11-Acq.
